description: This Java class demonstrates how BitmapOptions affect image loading and scaling in Android, specifically using inSampleSize for sub-sampling to reduce memory usage and load times.

classes.name: BitmapScaling
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating bitmap scaling techniques using BitmapFactory.Options and inSampleSize.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the original bitmap, and adds scaled versions to the layout.

methods.name: addScaledImageView
methods.description: Creates a scaled bitmap using inSampleSize, then adds it to the provided container layout.
